description: This file defines inline functions, templates, and class methods related to a dictionary (Dict) implementation in the ATen core library of PyTorch, including key comparison, hashing, and dictionary manipulation.

classes.name: Dict
classes.description: Template class implementing a dictionary with key-value pairs, supporting copy, insert, erase, find, and type management.

classes.name: DictImpl
classes.description: Internal implementation class for Dict, managing the underlying data structure and element types.

classes.name: DictKeyHash
classes.description: Hash functor for IValue keys used in Dict.

classes.name: DictKeyEqualTo
classes.description: Equality comparator for IValue keys used in Dict.

methods.name: Dict()
methods.description: Default constructor for Dict, initializes with key and value types.

methods.name: Dict(TypePtr keyType, TypePtr valueType)
methods.description: Constructor specifying key and value types.

methods.name: copy()
methods.description: Returns a copy of the dictionary.

methods.name: insert_or_assign()
methods.description: Inserts or assigns a key-value pair.

methods.name: erase()
methods.description: Erases element by iterator or key.

methods.name: is()
methods.description: Checks if two Dict instances are the same.
